answer: The mesa index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 569 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ember. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the kernel queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 491 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
